extracted.name: Easy Banana Muffins with Chocolate Chips
extracted.description: Not my own recipe but one I found a long time ago when trying new things and just really loved they make such a nice treat you can also swap out the chocolate chips or use nuts or fruit too
ingredient_lines: 5 tablespoons (70 g) unsalted butter melted and cooled slightly
3 ripe medium bananas mashed with a fork
3/4 cup (130 g) mini or regular size chocolate chips
instruction_lines: Heat oven to 176c or (350° Fahrenheit). Line muffin cups with paper liners. This recipe makes 12 regular-sized muffins.
Whisk the flour, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk the melted butter, mashed banana, egg, and vanilla until blended.
Add the banana mixture to the bowl with dry ingredients, then use a fork to combine. Do not overmix.
Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake until a toothpick can be inserted and comes out clean, 20 to 25 minutes.
